cards.scope: The Charge of the Light Brigade (1912 film)
cards.claim: The 1912 film The Charge of the Light Brigade was directed by J. Searle Dawley.
cards.quote: The Charge of the Light Brigade (1912 film) The Charge of the Light Brigade is a 1912 American short war film directed by J. Searle Dawley and starring James Gordon, Richard Neill and Charles Sutton.

cards.scope: Director of the 1968 film "Charge of the Light Brigade"

cards.quote: In 1968, director Tony Richardson made Charge of the Light Brigade, a British version of the story, starring Trevor Howard and Vanessa Redgrave (see AFI Catalog of Feature Films, 1961-70; F6.0745).

cards.quote: 12 Poland 01 Mar 1970 Theatrical 12 UK 10 Apr 1968 Theatrical USA 11 Oct 1968 Theatrical 139 mins More at IMDb TMDB Report this page Share Copy URL to Clipboard Tweet a link Share to Facebook Popular reviews More Review by Josh Gillam ★★★★ An ensemble cast including Trevor Howard , David Hemmings , Vanessa Redgrave and John Gielgud star in Tony Richardson ’ s period drama following the events that led up to the infamous charge during the Crimean War , spotlighting all the petty conflicts between officers who were meant to be on the same side .
